# Different Type of Vibe - Official Beat Store & Music Catalog
> High-quality Hip-Hop, Boom Bap, Trap, R&B, and Lo-Fi instrumental beats produced by Onzieb.

## Core Services & Beat Store Details
- Website: https://differenttypeofvibe.com
- Producer / Composer: Onzieb
- Audio Formats: Untagged 320kbps MP3, 24-bit Lossless WAV, Full STEMS Trackouts
- VIP Standard Pass Subscription: $9.99/month (5 Untagged WAV Commercial Leases every month, 100k streams)
- Pro Creator Pass Subscription: $24.99/month (UNLIMITED WAV Downloads + Full STEMS Trackouts)
- Annual VIP Pass: $89.99/year (60 WAV Beat Leases upfront, 25% savings)

- Beat Licensing Tiers:
  - MP3 Basic Lease: $29.99 (Instant untagged MP3, 100k streams)
  - WAV Premium Lease: $49.99 (Uncompressed 24-bit WAV studio quality)
  - STEMS Trackout License: $149.99 (Individual WAV channels for 808, drums, synths, FX)
- Genres: Trap Beats, Boom Bap Beats, R&B Instrumentals, Hip-Hop Beats, Lo-Fi Beats, Drill Beats, Synthwave
- Artist Style Vibes: Drake Type Beats, Travis Scott Type Beats, Metro Boomin Type Beats, J. Cole Type Beats, Future Type Beats, Playboi Carti Type Beats
